Compute the average fee rate (`feerate`, ignoring missing values) for each pair of orderslink and account scope (`users.acctscope`). queries:
WITH pair_averages AS (
  SELECT
    f.orderslink,
    u.acctscope,
    AVG(f.feerate) AS avg_fee_rate
  FROM fees AS f
  JOIN orders AS o ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault
  JOIN users AS u ON o.userlink = u.userstamp
  GROUP BY f.orderslink, u.acctscope
),
overall_mean AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_fee_rate) AS mean_pair_average
  FROM pair_averages
),
ranked_pairs AS (
  SELECT
    p.orderslink,
    p.acctscope,
    p.avg_fee_rate,
    p.avg_fee_rate - m.mean_pair_average AS excess,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY p.acctscope
      ORDER BY p.avg_fee_rate - m.mean_pair_average DESC
    ) AS pair_rank
  FROM pair_averages AS p
  CROSS JOIN overall_mean AS m
  WHERE p.avg_fee_rate > m.mean_pair_average
)
SELECT orderslink, acctscope, avg_fee_rate, excess, pair_rank
FROM ranked_pairs
WHERE pair_rank <= 3

WITH pair_averages AS (
    SELECT
        f.orderslink,
        u.acctscope,
        AVG(f.feerate) AS average_fee_rate
    FROM fees AS f
    JOIN orders AS o ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault
    JOIN users AS u ON o.userlink = u.userstamp
    GROUP BY f.orderslink, u.acctscope
),
overall_mean AS (
    SELECT AVG(average_fee_rate) AS mean_pair_average
    FROM pair_averages
),
ranked_pairs AS (
    SELECT
        p.orderslink,
        p.acctscope,
        p.average_fee_rate,
        p.average_fee_rate - m.mean_pair_average AS excess,
        RANK() OVER (
            PARTITION BY p.acctscope
            ORDER BY p.average_fee_rate - m.mean_pair_average DESC
        ) AS pair_rank
    FROM pair_averages AS p
    CROSS JOIN overall_mean AS m
    WHERE p.average_fee_rate > m.mean_pair_average
)
SELECT orderslink, acctscope, average_fee_rate, excess, pair_rank
FROM ranked_pairs
WHERE pair_rank <= 3
ORDER BY acctscope, pair_rank

WITH pair_averages AS (
  SELECT
    f.orderslink,
    u.acctscope,
    AVG(f.feerate) AS average_fee_rate
  FROM fees AS f
  JOIN orders AS o ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault
  JOIN users AS u ON o.userlink = u.userstamp
  GROUP BY f.orderslink, u.acctscope
),
excesses AS (
  SELECT
    orderslink,
    acctscope,
    average_fee_rate,
    average_fee_rate - (SELECT AVG(average_fee_rate) FROM pair_averages) AS excess
  FROM pair_averages
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT
    orderslink,
    acctscope,
    average_fee_rate,
    excess,
    DENSE_RANK() OVER (
      PARTITION BY acctscope
      ORDER BY excess DESC
    ) AS scope_rank
  FROM excesses
  WHERE excess > 0
)
SELECT orderslink, acctscope, average_fee_rate, excess, scope_rank
FROM ranked
WHERE scope_rank <= 3
ORDER BY acctscope, scope_rank, orderslink
